[[File:Crocodile akh icon.png|left]]
A '''crocodile akh '''is a [[Slayer monster]] that requires level 111 [[Slayer]] to kill. A [[feather of Ma'at]] is required to complete each kill. They can be found in the [[Sophanem Slayer Dungeon]]. The [[Slayer master]] [[Sumona]] has a high chance of assigning them.{{CiteForum|author = Mod Shauny|url = http://services.runescape.com/m=forum/l=0/sl=0/forums.ws?15,16,160,65917986|title = Patch Notes - 05/06|forum = Recent Game Updates|postdate = 5 June 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/25809436|archivedate=29 June 2017}}

Crocodile akhs have a special attack that triggers after five normal attacks where they will tail whip the player. This attack can deal massive (4,000+) damage at 0% [[Corrupted (status)|corruption]], although it is usually not a concern with sufficient weaponry, as a player can easily kill them before they can use it.
{{clear|left}}
